playable_definition.meaning: >=1 resident streamed chunk; loading screen begins fade. Gameplay input is then available while remaining boot stages finish.
playable_definition.not_playable_until: WorldBakeService.bootstrap_for_world_async returns (full 128x128 bake on cold, index load on warm)

found_before_cold.note: Previous bake was interrupted. Production treats missing index as miss and rebuilds all 16384 packages.

classification.bake.chunk_loop: synchronous main-thread world generation + mesh plan + disk I/O (not worker jobs)
classification.column_sample: synchronous main-thread world generation (InfiniteNoiseWorld worker-safe noise, but invoked on main)
classification.mesh_plan: synchronous main-thread mesh generation (ChunkManager._build_mesh / greedy plan)
classification.yield_wait: synchronization / waiting on SceneTree.process_frame (UI cooperative yield every 4 chunks)
classification.save_index: disk I/O (write world.index, then reread every .chk to sum sizes)
classification.feature_seeding: synchronous main-thread towns/ruins/spawns (runtime veg scatter skipped)
classification.initial_chunk_stream: worker-thread chunk apply + waiting on workers (tiny after bake)
classification.crystal: synchronous main, waits for spawn_area_ready; overlaps bake on cold
